sections.heading: eChipHub–SCL MPW Shuttle Programme: General FAQs

faqs.question: What is the eChipHub–SCL MPW Shuttle Programme?
faqs.answer: The programme provides an opportunity to submit eligible chip designs for fabrication at SCL Mohali using the 1.2 µm and 0.8 µm technology nodes.

faqs.question: Who can participate?
faqs.answer: Students, individual innovators, working professionals, researchers, startups, MSMEs, colleges and universities can participate. Students and individuals may submit designs independently.

faqs.question: What types of designs can be submitted?
faqs.answer: Both digital and analog IC designs can be submitted.

faqs.question: Is there a fee to participate or fabricate a design?
faqs.answer: There are currently no charges for design submission or fabrication under the shuttle programme.

faqs.question: Are packaging and delivery included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Packaging and delivery are included for the current shuttle.

faqs.question: Which PDKs are supported?
faqs.answer: The programme currently supports fabrication of designs based on the SCL 1.2 µm and 0.8 µm open-source PDKs.

faqs.question: Where can I download the PDKs and access design resources?
faqs.answer: Visit the SCL Open-Source PDK Access Portal to access the PDKs, reference documents, pre-configured VM images and example videos. https://verify.echiphub.in/

faqs.question: Are design tools and example flows available?
faqs.answer: Yes. The portal provides VM images with open-source EDA tools and the supported PDKs integrated, along with example videos for analog and digital design flows based on the 1.2 µm PDK.

faqs.question: Where can I find the design submission form and guidelines?
faqs.answer: Access the Design Tapeout Submission Form and review the relevant PDK documentation and design constraints in the SCL Open-Source PDK Access Portal. https://verify.echiphub.in/

faqs.question: Can designs be submitted for commercial purposes?
faqs.answer: Startups and MSMEs may submit test chips for fabrication to implement a proof of concept. If mass production is required for commercialization after tape-out, further discussions can be taken up with SCL.

faqs.question: Where can I get help or ask questions?
faqs.answer: Raise a ticket through the eChipHub Helpdesk and the support team will assist you. https://helpdesk.echiphub.in/
